title: 57 days to election: Peter Obi shares Anambra education record in ‘Go and Verify’ series, pledges national replication
summary: With 57 days until 16 January 2027, NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi continues his ‘Nigerians, Go and Verify’ series, detailing education investments as Anambra governor: five-classroom blocks in nearly all 177 communities, ~40,000 computers including 22,500+ HP laptops, Microsoft Academies, internet in schools, teacher recruitment, and improved national exam rankings. He pledges to prioritise quality education nationwide. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances people-centred representation focused on education and skills in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 58 days to election: Peter Obi clarifies US visit focused on democracy and credible elections, not endorsement
summary: With 58 days until 16 January 2027, NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi clarified that his Washington, DC meetings with US lawmakers were not to seek endorsement but to discuss Nigeria’s development, citizens’ welfare, stronger democratic institutions, and free, fair, transparent, credible elections that reflect the will of the people. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 59 days to election: Peter Obi meets US lawmakers, calls for stronger democratic institutions and credible elections
summary: With 59 days until 16 January 2027, NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi met US congressional leaders in Washington, DC, calling for stronger democratic institutions, free fair transparent and credible elections that reflect the will of the Nigerian people, accountable leadership, and international cooperation on security and economic prosperity. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 60 days to election: Peter Obi pledges 10,000 MW electricity, security and free education under NDC
summary: With 60 days until 16 January 2027, NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi continues town hall engagements across states, pledging to generate, transmit and distribute at least 10,000 megawatts of electricity, secure the nation so no mother loses her child, make basic education free and compulsory, and establish functional primary healthcare in every ward. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) advances people-centred representation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the vision. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 61 days to election: Peter Obi condemns attack on Kwankwaso’s convoy in Kano, demands investigation and arrests
summary: With 61 days until 16 January 2027, NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi has strongly condemned the reported attack on his running mate Rabiu Kwankwaso’s convoy in Bichi LGA, Kano State. Several entourage members were injured and about seven vehicles vandalised. Obi called for an immediate investigation, identification and arrest of those responsible, including any sponsors. Democracy is not warfare. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the message. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 62 days to election: Kwankwaso describes Peter Obi as incorruptible, pledges free education under NDC
summary: With 62 days until 16 January 2027, NDC Vice Presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso has described presidential candidate Peter Obi as incorruptible, noting it is key for governance. He pledged free education so no child is denied schooling. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the message. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 63 days to election: NDC tells Wike to stop distracting Nigerians and focus on economic hardship
summary: With 63 days until 16 January 2027, the NDC has called on FCT Minister Nyesom Wike to stop using the national anthem controversy at the Lagos town hall to distract from the economic hardship facing Nigerians. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the message and stay focused on the issues that matter. A New Nigeria is Possible.

title: 64 days to election: Peter Obi assures Nigerians their sacrifice for a New Nigeria won’t be in vain at Lagos town hall
summary: With 64 days until 16 January 2027, Peter Obi held a town hall in Ikeja, Lagos, assuring supporters that their sacrifices will not be in vain, condemning an attack on the venue, and pledging unity, security, 10,000 MW electricity, primary healthcare in every ward, and a shift from consumption to production. Locally, Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) continues people-centred mobilisation in Yewa North / Imeko-Afon. Share the message. A New Nigeria is Possible.
